title: macOS installer apps
explanation: These are full macOS installers, usually 13 to 18 GB each, left in Applications after an upgrade or download. macOS doesn't need them once the install is done.
consequence: To install that macOS version again later, you would download the installer again.

removal.instructions: Open Applications in Finder and drag the installer to the Trash. macOS asks for your password because the installer belongs to the system.
